artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan implementing the researched keep-plus-add outcome: keep playwright-verify.mjs as the required batch verification gate with a written justification, and add scoped Playwright MCP tools to the present extension as an optional ad hoc single-slide debugging capability.

memory_candidates.content: When a task asks to remove a 'duplicate' dependency, first separate the PACKAGE from the CODEPATH. A single package pin can serve two independent consumers - one removable, one structural. In the present extension, playwright-chromium serves both Slidev's own slidev-export PDF pipeline (an unremovable dependency of @slidev/cli itself) and a standalone verification script's independent browser-launch loop. Only the second is the duplicate in scope; the package pin cannot be removed under any outcome. Planning a removal against the package name rather than the codepath produces a plan that cannot succeed. A related permission-scope corollary: an MCP tool grant does not arrive transitively - a consuming extension needs its own settings-fragment.json plus a manifest merge_targets.settings entry, and adding the granting extension as a dependency instead drags in its unrelated agents, skills, and rules.
